name: Stabilization Baseline
objective: Lock production baseline, enforce orchestrator guardrails, normalize error/caching paths. Establish a verifiable, test-enforced foundation that all subsequent phases build upon.
gate: Gate A: Orchestrator-only routing checks and error mapping are test-enforced. No direct handler-to-engine execution paths exist. All 6 canonical workflows are registered and parity-checked at startup and CI.

risks.description: ConsciousnessEngine trait changes for required_inputs() method may break existing engine implementations
risks.mitigation: Add required_inputs() with default implementation returning empty Vec; engines opt-in gradually

risks.description: Cache key migration from old format to CacheKeyBuilder invalidates all existing cached data
risks.mitigation: Deploy cache key migration during low-traffic window; old keys expire naturally via TTL; no data loss, only cache misses

risks.description: Bridge engine tests require running TS sidecar, which may not be available in CI
risks.mitigation: Mock bridge endpoints in CI; integration tests with real TS sidecar run as nightly job only

risks.description: Compile-time dependency guards may break existing test utilities that import engine crates directly
risks.mitigation: Audit test dependencies before applying guards; allow dev-dependency exceptions for test utilities

risks.description: SHA-256 hashing for cache keys adds computational overhead vs DefaultHasher
risks.mitigation: Benchmark shows < 1ms overhead per key generation; acceptable for cache key construction path

risks.description: Integration test SIGTRAP on cleanup (known issue) may cause false CI failures
risks.mitigation: Use --test-threads=1 for integration tests; isolate cleanup with catch_unwind; document as known issue

verification_strategy: Gate A is verified through a 6-layer CI enforcement pipeline: (1) Orchestrator routing enforcement tests assert all engine and workflow requests pass through orchestrator, (2) Error mapping exhaustiveness compile-time check ensures no unmapped EngineError variants, (3) Workflow registry parity check ensures all 6 canonical workflows are registered at startup and in CI, (4) Cache key format validation ensures all engines use CacheKeyBuilder, (5) Input validation schema regression tests catch rule changes, (6) Aggregated P1 Gates summary check provides single pass/fail status. All gates must be green for PR merge. End-to-end integration tests cover the full request lifecycle: input validation -> orchestrator routing -> engine execution -> error mapping -> cache storage. The Gate A sign-off document provides final human verification that all automated gates are in place and passing.

task_summary.parallelism_opportunities: W1-S1, W1-S2, and W1-S3 tasks are largely independent and can run concurrently. W2-S1 (error mapping), W2-S2 (input validation), and W2-S3 (cache normalization) swarms can run in parallel after their respective W1 dependencies complete. W3 swarms depend on W2 completion but S1 (integration tests), S2 (CI gates), and S3 (documentation) within W3 can run concurrently.
